name: Local-first app suite for Boox Palma 2

mentions.name: Local-first app suite for Boox Palma 2
mentions.description: A suite of self-hosted, cloud-based local-first apps optimized for e-ink tablets, specifically the Boox Palma 2, including notes, a book reader, browser, music player, maps, and camera, with a companion iOS app combining them all so the user can disconnect and just grab the Palma.
mentions.problem: Wants to disconnect from a smartphone by having all needed apps on a distraction-free e-ink tablet.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A suite of own cloud based local first apps optimized for eink tablets, specifically the boox palma 2. Notes, book reader, browser, music player, maps, camera etc. With a companion ios app combining all of them.

this way when i want to disconnect i can just grab the palma and go
mentions.author: yoz-y
